bash_commands: ls -la && echo "---PARENT---" && ls -la .. && echo "---PROJECT---" && ls -la ../../.. 2>/dev/null | head -50
head -5 opsd_de_load.csv && echo "..." && tail -5 opsd_de_load.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l opsd_de_load.csv

which python3 && python3 --version && python3 -c "import pandas, numpy, matplotlib, sklearn; print('pandas',pandas.__version__,'numpy',numpy.__version__,'sklearn',sklearn.__version__,'mpl',matplotlib.__version__)" 2>&1 | head

ls /opt/homebrew/bin/python3* 2>/dev/null; for v in 3.11 3.12 3.13; do p=$(which python$v 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ]; then echo "python$v: $p"; python$v -c "import pandas,sklearn,matplotlib;print('  has pandas/sklearn/mpl')" 2>/dev/null || echo "  missing pkgs"; fi; done; echo "---"; which uv pipx 2>/dev/null
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.uv-cache" && uv venv .venv --python 3.13 2>&1 | tail -3 && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python pandas numpy scikit-learn matplotlib 2>&1 | tail -8
ls -la .venv/bin/python* 2>&1; echo "---"; find . -name pyproject.toml -o -name "*.toml" 2>/dev/null | grep -v uv-cache | head
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.uv-cache" && uv pip install --python "$PWD/.venv/bin/python" pandas numpy scikit-learn matplotlib 2>&1 | tail -8
rm -rf .venv && /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 -m venv .venv 2>&1 | tail -3 && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --quiet --upgrade pip 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo "pip-ok"

python3 -c "import os; print(os.path.realpath('.venv/bin'))" 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la@ .venv/bin 2>&1 | head; echo "---xattr on dir---"; xattr -l .venv/bin 2>&1 | head; echo "---cwd xattr---"; xattr . 2>&1

VENV=$HOME/.energy_forecast_venv && rm -rf "$VENV" && /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 -m venv "$VENV" 2>&1 | tail -3 && "$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet pandas numpy scikit-learn matplotlib 2>&1 | tail -5 && "$VENV/bin/python" -c "import pandas,sklearn,matplotlib,numpy;print('ready', pandas.__version__, sklearn.__version__)"

echo "empty/NaN load rows:"; awk -F, 'NR>1 && ($2=="" || $2=="NaN" || $2=="nan"){c++} END{print c+0}' opsd_de_load.csv
echo "rows around forecast window (2020-01-01):"; grep -n "^2020-01-01 00" opsd_de_load.csv; grep -n "^2020-01-07 23" opsd_de_load.csv; grep -n "^2019-12-31 23" opsd_de_load.csv
echo "duplicate timestamps:"; awk -F, 'NR>1{print $1}' opsd_de_load.csv | sort | uniq -d | head
